purpose: The Wallet Service manages customer wallet balances and executes top-ups, transfers, and profile changes for the Meridian Pay mobile app.

components.name: Mobile API Gateway
components.evidence: The Mobile app calls the Mobile API Gateway.

components.name: wallet-core
components.evidence: wallet-core holds the logic for balances and transfers

flows.evidence: The Mobile API Gateway is the only entrance for mobile traffic and forwards the requests of the app to wallet-core after it has checked the token of the customer with Keycloak.
wallet-core holds the logic for balances and transfers and reads and writes wallet-db (PostgreSQL), where balances and transactions are stored.
